messages:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT: P1  gateway_5xx_rate > 7% (5m). Notifying: @ops-oncall, @ingress-eng, @sre

ops-oncall: acked. I'm spinning up triage. seeing elevated 502/503s from multiple edge clusters. pulling graphs now.

ingress-jess: noticing a sudden spike in `upstream_rq_5xx` on route /v1/embeddings. correlates with a route-weight change at ~11:02 UTC that sent ~25% traffic to pool-b. pool-b latency is ~300ms vs pool-a ~60ms.

sre-tom: envoy stats show `retries` and `upstream_rq_pending_overflow` climbing then `circuit_breakers` tripping on several hosts. looks like retry amplification -> cb trips -> downstream 502s.

platform-raj: checking deploy logs... there was a change: ingress route weights updated at 11:02:18 by routing-ci. Could be the trigger.

ops-oncall: quick mitigation plan: 1) disable outgoing gateway retries to stop amplification, 2) roll back route weight to 11:01 state, 3) drain unhealthy hosts in pool-b, 4) post customer status. executing step 1 now.

ingress-jess: applying hotpatch to envoy clusters: set `retry_on: ""` and `num_retries: 0` for the affected host routes. patch: ```yaml
route:
  retry_policy:
    retry_on: ""
    num_retries: 0
```

status-bot: NOTE: Config change applied by ingress-jess at 2026-03-12T11:14:52Z

cs-oncall: CS seeing a handful of enterprise accounts reporting 502s. flagging top tier customers and opening outreach. @support-lead fyi.

sre-tom: after disabling retries, 5xx rate dropped 10.8% -> 2.9% on cluster-b within 45s. good delta. proceeding to roll back weight.

platform-raj: rolling back route weights to previous values. command used: ```bash
kubectl apply -f ingress-weights/previous.yaml
```

ops-oncall: routing reverted. kicking a drain on the few nodes showing continuous cb open.

ingress-jess: adding short-term per-route concurrency caps on /v1/embeddings to limit sudden fanout while pool-b warms. applied: `max_concurrent_requests: 200`, `max_pending_requests: 400`.

platform-raj: also nudged circuit breaker time windows so half-open retries happen more gradually (lower failure_threshold, longer reset_timeout) to avoid oscillation while hosts recover.

ops-oncall: running curl smoke concurrently against both pools (5 conc) returning 200s. sample: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"x"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

status-bot: Incident posted to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/IR-2026-62

cs-oncall: posting proactive banner to affected customers with ETA for resolution.

sre-tom: root-cause summary (working): traffic shift routed significant portion to pool-b which had cold caches and slightly higher p95 latency. client + gateway retries multiplied effective load, tripping Envoy circuit breakers and producing downstream 5xx.

platform-raj: immediate follow-ups: 1) gate route-weight changes behind slow-ramp (5m ramp minimum), 2) pre-warm target pools when reweighting, 3) make retry defaults conservative for high-fanout routes, 4) alert on retry amplification signature.

ingress-jess: PR created for hotpatch playbook and a rollback runbook: https://git.redwood.ai/ingress/playbooks/rollbacks/PR-189

ops-oncall: assigning owners: ingress-jess -> retry rollback playbook, platform-raj -> rollout gating & prewarm, sre-tom -> detection dashboard for retry amplification.

support-lead: prepping customer comms; will wait for final postmortem before attributing root cause.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated, monitoring. Severity -> P2.

ops-oncall: 5xx baseline restored to ~1.0% cluster-wide. leaving thread open for postmortem notes and timeline capture. scheduling RCA meeting tomorrow at 09:00 UTC. invite to @ingress-eng @sre @prod-platform @support.

ingress-jess: note for PM: add CI check that verifies target shard health before route weight flips. also add canary gate to block >10% immediate shift. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: thanks team. quick response. closing after RCA sync.
